podcast.body: This "straight up country song" written and recorded by Lionel Richie achieved a remarkable crossover success. It made the pop and R&B top 10 and also charted in the country charts top 25, an unprecedented feat at the time. "Lionel Richie, who wrote and recorded a straight up country song called Stuck on You, that made the pop and R&B top 10, and even the country charts top 25, an unprecedented chart crossover at the time."
